summary: 33-year-old male stuck hiker on the west side of Mt. Toll, Indian Peaks Wilderness; fell ~15 ft into a slick near-vertical gully while traversing Mt. Toll on a Brainard Lake/Mt. Audubon/Pawnee Pass loop; minor injuries; called 911 ~12:50 p.m.; GCSAR requested Boulder County assistance after thunderstorms grounded helicopter; RMRG hiked in from Brainard Lake, fixed ropes and descended ~600 ft of steep rock; harnessed and belayed him to the ridge; reached the Continental Divide ~3:15 a.m. July 4; evaluated and hiked out; ~18-hour rescue; BCSO case #22-03123
location: west side of Mt. Toll, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Grand County SAR, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Flight for Life Colorado, Medevac
notes: incident in Grand County; Boulder County assisted because thunderstorms over the divide grounded helicopter insertion | BCSO release case 22-03123 appended (merged run 526): hiker in Grand County, rescue staged from Boulder side via Brainard Lake; ~18-hr effort, minor injuries
